Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at jobaidapack.com — the product range is solid: corrugated cartons, mailer boxes, rigid boxes, and you have a 'Get a Quote' flow and order tracking. That's more digital infrastructure than most packaging manufacturers in Bangladesh.

But here's the gap I see: your 'Get a Quote' form is a standard contact form — no instant pricing, no specification wizard, no automated follow-up. For e-commerce brands ordering custom mailer boxes, they want to know 'how much for 500 boxes with full-color printing?' right now, not after a manual callback. And your 'Track Order' feature requires a phone call (+8801568316131) — no self-service tracking.

I built an AI sales agent that qualifies incoming quote requests automatically — asks for box type, dimensions, quantity, printing specs, and delivery timeline, then generates a preliminary quote range and books a call with your sales team. For existing orders, it provides self-service tracking via WhatsApp. Your sales team stops spending time on unqualified enquiries and focuses on closing.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
